findings.title: Checker still permits forged authority and structured credential values
findings.observation: The new contract forbids production lifecycle overrides and allows a test override only for an isolated repository with external non-link files. The checker only proves that the repository is located under os.tmpdir, so a production-shaped clone with the real GitHub origin and CI environment accepts fully fabricated lifecycle state. It also resolves the state path before lstat, allowing a symlink to masquerade as a regular file. Separately, the credential scanner unconditionally exempts values beginning with '[' or '{', so api_key arrays and token objects receive PASS.
findings.trigger: A caller places a production-shaped checkout under a temporary directory and supplies fabricated lifecycle state, supplies that state through a symlink, or commits a credential under a structured value.
findings.impact: The checker emits authorization-grade exit 0 and 13/13 PASS for untrusted lifecycle authority or committed credential values. A contributor can therefore advance a projection without canonical workflow facts or expose a production credential while the advertised gate remains green.

evidence.description: The tracked input and output contracts forbid production overrides, require external non-link test fixtures and require terminal credential-key scanning.
A production-shaped temporary checkout and a symlinked state override both return PASS; primary summary SHA-256 is 9a0dce60cf2f54a0704a071d544f79376870404d997b863669c5c2245286e908.
Committed api_key array and token object values both return 13/13 PASS; summary SHA-256 is 1c038f93d13ff2fa81ebc81737e29c18e18d55cf8e3323efac06cebf3df13cea.
The refreshed stock harness has no production-like override attestation or structured credential fixture.
A separate fresh-context audit independently confirmed the structured-secret bypass.

findings.remediation: Remove lifecycle override support from the production entry point or require an unforgeable test-only capability/build boundary that cannot be satisfied by repository location and environment variables. Apply lstat to the supplied path before realpath and bind an explicit fixture identity. Recursively inspect array/object values assigned to sensitive terminal keys while keeping diagnostic values redacted.
findings.verification: At a new exact head, the valid Draft snapshot must remain deterministic. A production-shaped temporary checkout with fabricated state, direct and symlinked overrides, and scalar/array/object credential assignments must fail under the intended check; an isolated attested harness fixture must remain usable.

findings.title: Half of the documented lifecycle transitions cannot validate
findings.observation: The public design defines Deferred as a first-class status and sixteen guarded transition rows. The checker omits Deferred from its durable-stage mapping and omits eight edges: Draft/Ready/In Progress/Blocked/In Review to Deferred, Deferred to Draft/Ready, and Accepted to Draft. Its unconditional expected-authority check therefore rejects valid public workflows; Draft-to-Deferred is additionally forced through Ready-style RequirementsHandoff and PASS-plan evidence.
findings.trigger: A plan is explicitly deferred, resumed from Deferred, or reopened from Accepted using one of the documented guards.
findings.impact: Eight of sixteen supported transitions fail closed even with otherwise valid evidence. Main cannot represent documented defer, resume or reopen behavior, so the checker and public lifecycle contract disagree on recovery-critical states.

evidence.description: The approved design enumerates all seven statuses and sixteen transition rows, including eight Deferred/reopen edges.

A Ready-to-Deferred projection fails with 'authority bundle transition is invalid or not role-bound' and 'plan status does not match the current durable lifecycle feature stage'; primary summary SHA-256 is 9a0dce60cf2f54a0704a071d544f79376870404d997b863669c5c2245286e908.
Static mapping inspection finds no Deferred durable stage and only eight of sixteen documented transition edges.
The independent audit reached the same edge-set mismatch without prior finding context.

findings.remediation: Implement a durable authority model for Deferred and every documented transition edge, including distinct defer, recovery and reopen authorities rather than reusing Ready prerequisites. Keep the edge table in one exhaustive source so the public design and checker cannot drift.
findings.verification: Add positive end-to-end fixtures for all sixteen edges and each seven-state projection, backed by matching durable authority; retain negative fixtures for wrong roles, wrong source/target, stale projections and missing recovery evidence.

findings.title: GitHub authority resolution truncates collections at 100 items

location.symbol: Canonical lifecycle and GitHub authority resolution

findings.observation: The checker requests PR files, check runs and reviews with per_page=100 but never follows pagination. It then compares changed_files or total_count to the first page length and searches only that page for required checks and AcceptanceOwner review. The contract describes each collection as complete authority, not a first-page subset.
findings.trigger: A valid implementation PR changes more than 100 files, a check suite yields more than 100 runs, or the AcceptanceOwner's authoritative review falls after the first 100 reviews.
findings.impact: Valid In Review or Accepted projections fail solely because authoritative GitHub history exceeds one page. The gate becomes non-scalable and can block the documented lifecycle without any contract violation.

evidence.description: The tracked algorithm requires the complete live PR file set, complete repository-required check set and exact AcceptanceOwner review.
The GitHub resolver uses per_page=100 for PR files, checks and reviews with no page loop or Link-header handling.
The independent audit traced every list call and confirmed the first-page-only comparisons.

findings.remediation: Paginate every GitHub list endpoint until the collection is complete, reject inconsistent counts, canonicalize the entire ordered observation into authoritySnapshotDigest and make rate-limit/API failures explicit.
findings.verification: Add deterministic boundary fixtures at 100 and 101 PR files, check runs and reviews, including a required check and AcceptanceOwner review present only on page two; both valid snapshots must pass and missing-page authority must fail closed.
